build_graph_network: build a GraphNetwork by passing update_edge_fn, update_node_fn, and update_global_fn to configure a graph neural network
create_attention_graph_network: create a GraphNetwork with attention_logit_fn and attention_reduce_fn to enable softmax attention over incoming edge features
apply_graph_network: apply a configured GraphNetwork to a GraphsTuple to update nodes, edges, and globals in a single forward pass
configure_edge_aggregation: configure edge aggregation for globals by setting normalize_edges_for_globals_by_nodes to average edge features per graph
summarize_graph_network: summarize the GraphNetwork function that implements Algorithm 1 from the GraphNets paper with separate sender and receiver edge aggregations
